Expo/React Native best practices.

Structure: `assets/`; `src/`; `src/components/`; `src/screens/`; `src/navigation/` (unless Expo Router `app/`); `src/hooks/`; `src/utils/`; `src/services/`. Directories `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; hooks/utils and variables/functions `camelCase`; global constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`.

Always use functional components.
All new code must be in TypeScript.
Centralize styles with `StyleSheet`.
Use `app/` directory for routing; use `app/_layout.tsx`, `app/index.tsx`, `app/profile/[id].tsx`, and `useLocalSearchParams`.
❌ BAD: Manual stack/tab navigator setup in a single file for all routes.
Always create new objects/arrays when updating state.
Carefully manage `useEffect` dependencies.
Use `.env` files with `EXPO_PUBLIC_` for client-side variables.
❌ BAD: `API_KEY=mysecret` in `.env` and `process.env.API_KEY`. (Exposed in bundle, not automatically injected)
Never store sensitive keys (e.g., private API keys) in `EXPO_PUBLIC_` variables. They are bundled client-side. Use EAS Secrets for server-side secrets.
Use `React.memo`, `useCallback`, `useMemo`, and lazy loading with `React.lazy`/`Suspense` appropriately.
Use robust async error handling with `try/catch`; log failures and display user-friendly messages.
